tokens.bg: Page background behind the dot grid; also text on solid blue and green fills (primary button, NORMAL badge) and the fill of tags.
tokens.bg-dark: Window bodies and other raised panels; also the colour of the hard offset retro-shadow.
tokens.bg-highlight: Window title bars (at 50% over bg-dark), hover rows and text selection.
tokens.border: Every 1px border (windows, tags, buttons), the dot grid and the section-title rule.
tokens.fg: Headings, the hero name and emphasised text on bg, bg-dark and bg-highlight.
tokens.fg-dark: Default body text (set on body) on bg and bg-dark.
tokens.comment: Muted text in the voice of a code comment: `// location`, prompts, window titles, metadata. Night value lifted from Tokyo Night's #565f89 to reach WCAG AA on bg and bg-dark.
tokens.blue: The one interactive accent: links, hover and focus borders, section numbers, the cursor and the primary button fill.
tokens.cyan: Tag text, inline code and URLs, the `you ›` prompt and link hover.
tokens.magenta: Keywords and speakers: the hero title line, `agent ›` and `mcp ›` prompts, `export const`, company names.
tokens.orange: Rare: the light-theme sun glyph in the theme toggle and the border of an unavailable chat notice.
tokens.yellow: Commit hashes, tool calls such as `get_contact()`, the in-progress badge and the middle traffic-light dot.
tokens.green: Strings and success: list bullets, highlights, the NORMAL status badge, the HEAD commit dot and the green traffic-light dot. Night value softened from Tokyo Night's #9ece6a.
tokens.teal: Object keys in the code-styled stack section only.
tokens.red: Error notices and the red traffic-light dot; never decorative.
tokens.scanline: The CRT scanline overlay fixed over the whole page (a 3px repeating gradient); not for text or fills.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: The h1 only. Fluid on the site: clamp(2.5rem, 6.5vw, 4.5rem), so 40px on phones up to 72px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2 in fg, 24px/32px below the sm breakpoint. Its number is set in sans semibold, blue.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The line under the hero name, in magenta after a comment-coloured `> `; 18px/28px on phones.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The most used size: terminal output, buttons, list items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags, window titles, terminal buttons, metadata.

styles.name: prose-sm
styles.usage: Human-voice quotes inside cards, in fg after a 2px green left rule. Sans marks the change from terminal output to prose.

tokens.space-1: Tight vertical padding on small controls.
tokens.space-2: The default gap between inline items; tag and button horizontal padding.
tokens.space-3: Window title-bar horizontal padding; gap between hero buttons.
tokens.space-4: Page side gutter on phones; button horizontal padding.
tokens.space-6: Page side gutter and window body padding from sm up; the dot-grid pitch.
tokens.space-16: Section vertical padding from sm up; hero top padding on phones.
tokens.space-24: Hero top padding from sm up.

tokens.retro-shadow: The only shadow: a hard, unblurred offset in bg-dark under windows and the primary button.
